# Corpus of shell command lines with their expected analysis.
#
# Format. A case starts with `$ <command>` (bash), `$ps <command>` (PowerShell) or
# `$cmd <command>` (cmd.exe). Lines starting with `| ` continue the command on a new line.
# Each following `> {json}` line is one expected simple command, in order (see
# tests/common/mod.rs for the fields); `> !incomplete` expects `complete = false`; `> (none)` expects no commands. A case
# without any `>` line is new: run the test with ACS_SHELL_BLESS=1 to fill in what the analysis
# produces, then review it before committing. Lines starting with `#` are comments.

# ---- rm and friends ----------------------------------------------------------------------
$ rm file.txt
> {"w":"rm file.txt","c":"delete","t":["delete file.txt"]}
$ rm -rf build
> {"w":"rm -rf build","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec build"]}
$ rm -rf build/ dist/
> {"w":"rm -rf build/ dist/","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec build/","delete+rec dist/"]}
$ rm -f *.log
> {"w":"rm -f *.log","c":"delete","t":["delete+glob *.log"]}
$ rm -rf build/*
> {"w":"rm -rf build/*","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+glob build/*"]}
$ rm -rf "$VAR"/
> {"w":"rm -rf $VAR/","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $VAR/"]}
$ rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}/out"
> {"w":"rm -rf ${BUILD_DIR}/out","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial ${BUILD_DIR}/out"]}
$ rm -rf $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tmp
> {"w":"rm -rf \"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tmp\"","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tmp"]}
> {"w":"git rev-parse --show-toplevel","c":"read","g":"rev-parse"}
$ rm -- -weird-file
> {"w":"rm -- -weird-file","c":"delete","t":["delete -weird-file"]}
$ rm -rf -- "$dir"
> {"w":"rm -rf -- $dir","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $dir"]}
$ rm -r --force target
> {"w":"rm -r --force target","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec target"]}
$ rmdir empty_dir
> {"w":"rmdir empty_dir","c":"delete","t":["delete empty_dir"]}
$ unlink link
> {"w":"unlink link","c":"delete","t":["delete link"]}
$ shred -u secret.key
> {"w":"shred -u secret.key","c":"delete","t":["delete secret.key"]}
$ rm -rf /
> {"w":"rm -rf /","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec /"]}
$ rm -rf ~/projects/old
> {"w":"rm -rf ~/projects/old","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial ~/projects/old"]}
$ rm -rf node_modules .next
> {"w":"rm -rf node_modules .next","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec node_modules","delete+rec .next"]}
$ rm "file with spaces.txt"
> {"w":"rm \"file with spaces.txt\"","c":"delete","t":["delete file with spaces.txt"]}
$ rm 'it'\''s.txt'
> {"w":"rm it's.txt","c":"delete","t":["delete it's.txt"]}
$ rm \*.txt
> {"w":"rm *.txt","c":"delete","t":["delete *.txt"]}
$ rm "*.txt"
> {"w":"rm *.txt","c":"delete","t":["delete *.txt"]}
$ rm file{1,2,3}.txt
> {"w":"rm file{1,2,3}.txt","c":"delete","t":["delete+glob file{1,2,3}.txt"]}
$ rm -rf ./build/../dist
> {"w":"rm -rf ./build/../dist","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ./build/../dist"]}
$ rm $HOME/x
> {"w":"rm $HOME/x","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial $HOME/x"]}
$ rm ~/x
> {"w":"rm ~/x","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial ~/x"]}
$ rm "$(pwd)/x"
> {"w":"rm $(pwd)/x","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial $(pwd)/x"]}
> {"w":"pwd","c":"read"}
$ rm -rf ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/acs
> {"w":"rm -rf ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/acs","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/acs"]}
$ rm -rf /tmp/acs-*
> {"w":"rm -rf /tmp/acs-*","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+glob /tmp/acs-*"]}
$ rm *.o
> {"w":"rm *.o","c":"delete","t":["delete+glob *.o"]}
$ rm file[0-9].txt
> {"w":"rm file[0-9].txt","c":"delete","t":["delete+glob file[0-9].txt"]}
$ rm ??.log
> {"w":"rm ??.log","c":"delete","t":["delete+glob ??.log"]}
$ rm -rf
> {"w":"rm -rf","c":"delete"}
$ ! rm x
> {"w":"rm x","c":"delete","t":["delete x"]}

# ---- find --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ find . -name '*.tmp' -delete
> {"w":"find . -name *.tmp -delete","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ."]}
$ find /tmp -type f -mtime +7 -delete
> {"w":"find /tmp -type f -mtime +7 -delete","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec /tmp"]}
$ find . -name '*.pyc' -exec rm {} \;
> {"w":"find . -name *.pyc -exec rm {} ;","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ."]}
$ find . -type f -name '*.orig' -exec rm -f {} +
> {"w":"find . -type f -name *.orig -exec rm -f {} +","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ."]}
$ find src -name '*.rs' | xargs grep TODO
> {"w":"find src -name *.rs","c":"read","t":["read+rec src"]}
> {"w":"xargs grep TODO","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
> {"w":"find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ."]}
$ find . -type f
> {"w":"find . -type f","c":"read","t":["read+rec ."]}
$ find . -name '*.log' -print0 | xargs -0 rm -f
> {"w":"find . -name *.log -print0","c":"read","t":["read+rec ."]}
> {"w":"xargs -0 rm -f","c":"delete,unknown","u":true}
$ find . -name '-delete' -print
> {"w":"find . -name -delete -print","c":"read","t":["read+rec ."]}
$ find . -exec chmod 644 {} \;
> {"w":"find . -exec chmod 644 {} ;","c":"write","t":["write+rec ."]}
$ find . -exec sh -c 'rm -f "$1"' _ {} \;
> {"w":"find . -exec sh -c \"rm -f \\\"$1\\\"\" _ {} ;","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"rm -f $1","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial $1"]}
$ find build -mindepth 1 -delete
> {"w":"find build -mindepth 1 -delete","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec build"]}
$ find . -name '*.txt' -fprint list.txt
> {"w":"find . -name *.txt -fprint list.txt","c":"write","t":["write list.txt"]}
$ find $DIR -delete
> {"w":"find $DIR -delete","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $DIR"]}
$ find
> {"w":"find","c":"read","t":["read+rec ."]}

# ---- xargs -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ git ls-files | xargs rm
> {"w":"git ls-files","c":"read","g":"ls-files"}
> {"w":"xargs rm","c":"delete,unknown","u":true}
$ ls *.tmp | xargs -n1 rm -f
> {"w":"ls *.tmp","c":"read","t":["read+glob *.tmp"]}
> {"w":"xargs -n1 rm -f","c":"delete,unknown","u":true}
$ ls | xargs -I{} cp {} backup/
> {"w":"ls","c":"read"}
> {"w":"xargs -I{} cp {} backup/","c":"write,unknown","t":["write+rec backup/"],"u":true}
$ cat files.txt | xargs -I% mv % archive/
> {"w":"cat files.txt","c":"read","t":["read files.txt"]}
> {"w":"xargs -I% mv % archive/","c":"move,unknown","t":["write+rec archive/"],"u":true}
$ echo foo | xargs
> {"w":"echo foo","c":"read"}
> {"w":"xargs","c":"read"}
$ git diff --name-only | xargs sed -i 's/a/b/'
> {"w":"git diff --name-only","c":"read","g":"diff"}
> {"w":"xargs sed -i s/a/b/","c":"write,unknown","u":true}
$ xargs -0 -P4 -n1 shred
> {"w":"xargs -0 -P4 -n1 shred","c":"delete,unknown","u":true}
$ fd -e tmp -x rm
> {"w":"fd -e tmp -x rm","c":"delete,unknown","u":true}
$ ls | xargs -I{} sh -c 'rm -rf {}'
> {"w":"ls","c":"read"}
> {"w":"xargs -I{} sh -c \"rm -rf {}\"","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"rm -rf $__ARG__","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $__ARG__"]}

# ---- mv, cp, ln, mkdir, touch ------------------------------------------------------------
$ mv a.txt b.txt
> {"w":"mv a.txt b.txt","c":"move","t":["delete+rec a.txt","write+rec b.txt"]}
$ mv src/old.rs src/new.rs
> {"w":"mv src/old.rs src/new.rs","c":"move","t":["delete+rec src/old.rs","write+rec src/new.rs"]}
$ mv *.log logs/
> {"w":"mv *.log logs/","c":"move","t":["delete+rec+glob *.log","write+rec logs/"]}
$ mv -t dest a b
> {"w":"mv -t dest a b","c":"move","t":["delete+rec a","delete+rec b","write+rec dest"]}
$ cp a b
> {"w":"cp a b","c":"write","t":["read a","write+rec b"]}
$ cp -r src backup
> {"w":"cp -r src backup","c":"write","t":["read+rec src","write+rec backup"]}
$ cp -a src/. dest/
> {"w":"cp -a src/. dest/","c":"write","t":["read+rec src/.","write+rec dest/"]}
$ cp file1 file2 dir/
> {"w":"cp file1 file2 dir/","c":"write","t":["read file1","read file2","write+rec dir/"]}
$ cp -t dir a b
> {"w":"cp -t dir a b","c":"write","t":["read a","read b","write+rec dir"]}
$ ln -s target link
> {"w":"ln -s target link","c":"write","t":["write+rec link"]}
$ ln -sf ../shared/config.json config.json
> {"w":"ln -sf ../shared/config.json config.json","c":"write","t":["write+rec config.json"]}
$ install -m 755 target/release/acs /usr/local/bin/acs
> {"w":"install -m 755 target/release/acs /usr/local/bin/acs","c":"write","t":["read target/release/acs","write+rec /usr/local/bin/acs"]}
$ install -d out/bin
> {"w":"install -d out/bin","c":"write","t":["write out/bin"]}
$ touch a b
> {"w":"touch a b","c":"write","t":["write a","write b"]}
$ mkdir -p build/out
> {"w":"mkdir -p build/out","c":"write","t":["write build/out"]}
$ mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/acs"
> {"w":"mkdir -p $HOME/.cache/acs","c":"write","t":["write+partial $HOME/.cache/acs"]}
$ truncate -s 0 app.log
> {"w":"truncate -s 0 app.log","c":"write","t":["write app.log"]}
$ tee out.log
> {"w":"tee out.log","c":"write","t":["write out.log"]}
$ echo hi | tee -a a.log b.log
> {"w":"echo hi","c":"read"}
> {"w":"tee -a a.log b.log","c":"write","t":["write a.log","write b.log"]}
$ dd if=/dev/zero of=disk.img bs=1M count=10
> {"w":"dd if=/dev/zero of=disk.img bs=1M count=10","c":"write","t":["read /dev/zero","write disk.img"]}
$ dd if=a.iso of=/dev/sdb
> {"w":"dd if=a.iso of=/dev/sdb","c":"write","t":["read a.iso","write /dev/sdb"]}
$ chmod +x script.sh
> {"w":"chmod +x script.sh","c":"write","t":["write script.sh"]}
$ chmod -R 755 dist
> {"w":"chmod -R 755 dist","c":"write","t":["write+rec dist"]}
$ chmod -x file
> {"w":"chmod -x file","c":"write","t":["write file"]}
$ chown -R user:group data
> {"w":"chown -R user:group data","c":"write","t":["write+rec data"]}
$ mktemp -d
> {"w":"mktemp -d","c":"write"}
$ mktemp /tmp/foo.XXXXXX
> {"w":"mktemp /tmp/foo.XXXXXX","c":"write","t":["write /tmp/foo.XXXXXX"]}

# ---- sed, awk, perl, sort ----------------------------------------------------------------
$ sed -i 's/foo/bar/g' src/main.rs
> {"w":"sed -i s/foo/bar/g src/main.rs","c":"write","t":["write src/main.rs"]}
$ sed -i.bak 's/foo/bar/' a.txt b.txt
> {"w":"sed -i.bak s/foo/bar/ a.txt b.txt","c":"write","t":["write a.txt","write b.txt"]}
$ sed -n '1,10p' file.txt
> {"w":"sed -n 1,10p file.txt","c":"read","t":["read file.txt"]}
$ sed -i '' -e 's/a/b/' file
> {"w":"sed -i \"\" -e s/a/b/ file","c":"write","t":["write file"]}
$ sed -e 's/x/y/' -e 's/a/b/' < in > out
> {"w":"sed -e s/x/y/ -e s/a/b/","c":"write","t":["read in","write out"]}
$ awk '{print $1}' data.csv
> {"w":"awk \"{print $1}\" data.csv","c":"read","t":["read data.csv"]}
$ awk -F, '{print $2 > "out.txt"}' data.csv
> {"w":"awk -F, \"{print $2 > \\\"out.txt\\\"}\" data.csv","c":"write,unknown","t":["read data.csv"],"u":true}
$ awk 'BEGIN { system("rm -rf x") }'
> {"w":"awk \"BEGIN { system(\\\"rm -rf x\\\") }\"","c":"write,unknown","u":true}
$ awk '$3 > 100' data
> {"w":"awk \"$3 > 100\" data","c":"read","t":["read data"]}
$ perl -pi -e 's/a/b/' a.txt b.txt
> {"w":"perl -pi -e s/a/b/ a.txt b.txt","c":"write","t":["write a.txt","write b.txt"]}
$ perl -i.bak -pe 's/a/b/' file
> {"w":"perl -i.bak -pe s/a/b/ file","c":"write","t":["write file"]}
$ perl -e 'print 1'
> {"w":"perl -e \"print 1\"","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ sort -o sorted.txt unsorted.txt
> {"w":"sort -o sorted.txt unsorted.txt","c":"write","t":["read unsorted.txt","write sorted.txt"]}
$ sort file | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
> {"w":"sort file","c":"read","t":["read file"]}
> {"w":"uniq -c","c":"read"}
> {"w":"sort -rn","c":"read"}
> {"w":"head","c":"read"}

# ---- reading and redirection -------------------------------------------------------------
$ cat README.md
> {"w":"cat README.md","c":"read","t":["read README.md"]}
$ cat a b | wc -l
> {"w":"cat a b","c":"read","t":["read a","read b"]}
> {"w":"wc -l","c":"read"}
$ ls -la
> {"w":"ls -la","c":"read"}
$ ls -R src
> {"w":"ls -R src","c":"read","t":["read+rec src"]}
$ head -n 20 log.txt
> {"w":"head -n 20 log.txt","c":"read","t":["read log.txt"]}
$ tail -f app.log
> {"w":"tail -f app.log","c":"read","t":["read app.log"]}
$ grep -rn TODO src/
> {"w":"grep -rn TODO src/","c":"read","t":["read+rec src/"]}
$ grep -r --include='*.rs' foo .
> {"w":"grep -r --include=*.rs foo .","c":"read","t":["read+rec ."]}
$ grep -e foo -e bar file
> {"w":"grep -e foo -e bar file","c":"read","t":["read file"]}
$ rg 'fn main' src
> {"w":"rg \"fn main\" src","c":"read","t":["read+rec src"]}
$ rg -n --type rust unsafe
> {"w":"rg -n --type rust unsafe","c":"read"}
$ diff a.txt b.txt
> {"w":"diff a.txt b.txt","c":"read","t":["read a.txt","read b.txt"]}
$ wc -l src/*.rs
> {"w":"wc -l src/*.rs","c":"read","t":["read+glob src/*.rs"]}
$ jq '.name' package.json
> {"w":"jq .name package.json","c":"read","t":["read package.json"]}
$ jq -r '.[]' data.json > out.json
> {"w":"jq -r .[] data.json","c":"write","t":["read data.json","write out.json"]}
$ du -sh *
> {"w":"du -sh *","c":"read","t":["read+glob *"]}
$ stat file
> {"w":"stat file","c":"read","t":["read file"]}
$ echo $PATH
> {"w":"echo $PATH","c":"read"}
$ echo "hello" > greeting.txt
> {"w":"echo hello","c":"write","t":["write greeting.txt"]}
$ echo hi >> log.txt
> {"w":"echo hi","c":"write","t":["write log.txt"]}
$ cat a > b
> {"w":"cat a","c":"write","t":["read a","write b"]}
$ cmd &> all.log
> {"w":"cmd","c":"unknown,write","t":["write all.log"],"u":true}
$ cmd > out.log 2>&1
> {"w":"cmd","c":"unknown,write","t":["write out.log"],"u":true}
$ cmd 2> err.log
> {"w":"cmd","c":"unknown,write","t":["write err.log"],"u":true}
$ cmd < input.txt
> {"w":"cmd","c":"unknown","t":["read input.txt"],"u":true}
$ cmd > /dev/null 2>&1
> {"w":"cmd","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ echo x >| force.txt
> {"w":"echo x","c":"write","t":["write force.txt"]}
$ printf '%s\n' a b > list.txt
> {"w":"printf \"%s\\\\n\" a b","c":"write","t":["write list.txt"]}
$ cat <<EOF > config.toml
| key = "value"
| EOF
> {"w":"cat","c":"write","t":["write config.toml"]}
$ cat <<'EOF'
| rm -rf /
| EOF
> {"w":"cat","c":"read"}
$ cat <<EOF
| $(rm -rf x)
| EOF
> {"w":"cat","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf x","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec x"]}
$ cat <<< "text" > f
> {"w":"cat","c":"write","t":["write f"]}
$ exec > log.txt
> {"w":"exec","c":"write","t":["write log.txt"]}
$ cat file | tee out.txt | wc -l
> {"w":"cat file","c":"read","t":["read file"]}
> {"w":"tee out.txt","c":"write","t":["write out.txt"]}
> {"w":"wc -l","c":"read"}
$ echo $'a\tb' > $'tab\tname'
> {"w":"echo \"a\\tb\"","c":"write","t":["write tab\tname"]}

# ---- build tools, package managers, interpreters -----------------------------------------
$ python -m pytest tests/ -x
> {"w":"python -m pytest tests/ -x","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ python -m venv .venv
> {"w":"python -m venv .venv","c":"write","t":["write+rec .venv"]}
$ python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
> {"w":"python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt","c":"network,write"}
$ make clean

# ---- chains, directories, control flow ---------------------------------------------------
$ cd sub && rm -rf build
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf build","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec sub/build"]}
$ cd sub; rm -rf build
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf build","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec sub/build"]}
$ cd .. && rm -rf x
> {"w":"cd ..","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf x","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec ../x"]}
$ cd sub && cd .. && rm -rf x
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"cd ..","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf x","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec x"]}
$ cd /tmp && rm -rf x
> {"w":"cd /tmp","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf x","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec /tmp/x"]}
$ cd && rm -rf x
> {"w":"cd","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf x","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial x"]}
$ cd - && rm x
> {"w":"cd -","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm x","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial x"]}
$ (cd sub && rm -rf out); rm -rf out2
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf out","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec sub/out"]}
> {"w":"rm -rf out2","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec out2"]}
$ { cd sub; rm x; }; rm y
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm x","c":"delete","t":["delete sub/x"]}
> {"w":"rm y","c":"delete","t":["delete sub/y"]}
$ cd sub || exit 1; rm -rf out
> {"w":"cd sub","c":"read"}
> {"w":"exit 1","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf out","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec sub/out"]}
$ mkdir out && cd out && touch a
> {"w":"mkdir out","c":"write","t":["write out"]}
> {"w":"cd out","c":"read"}
> {"w":"touch a","c":"write","t":["write out/a"]}
$ cd "$DIR" && rm -rf *
> {"w":"cd $DIR","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm -rf *","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial *"]}
$ for f in *.tmp; do rm "$f"; done
> {"w":"rm $f","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial $f"]}
$ for d in a b c; do rm -rf $d/build; done
> {"w":"rm -rf $d/build","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec+partial $d/build"]}
$ for d in */; do (cd "$d" && make clean); done
> {"w":"cd $d","c":"read"}
> {"w":"make clean","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ while read f; do rm "$f"; done < files.txt
> {"w":"read f","c":"read","t":["read files.txt"]}
> {"w":"rm $f","c":"delete","t":["delete+partial $f"]}
$ if [ -f x ]; then rm x; fi
> {"w":"rm x","c":"delete","t":["delete x"]}
$ [ -d build ] && rm -rf build
> {"w":"rm -rf build","c":"delete","t":["delete+rec build"]}
$ test -f x || touch x
> {"w":"test -f x","c":"read"}
> {"w":"touch x","c":"write","t":["write x"]}
$ cmd1 && cmd2 || cmd3
> {"w":"cmd1","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"cmd2","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"cmd3","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ a; b; c
> {"w":"a","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"b","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"c","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ a | b | c
> {"w":"a","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"b","c":"unknown","u":true}
> {"w":"c","c":"unknown","u":true}
$ ls & rm x
> {"w":"ls","c":"read"}
> {"w":"rm x","c":"delete","t":["delete x"]}
